newsitem.title: POLAND: Salomon Brothers bullish on Polish treasuries.
newsitem.headline: Salomon Brothers bullish on Polish treasuries.

text.p: Solomon Brothers recommended taking an overweight position in Polish local currency instruments in its Emerging Market Debt Strategy and Currency Recommendations report dated January 21, 1997.

It said 12-month T-bills, last sold with an average yield of 19.97 percent were attractive, assuming the rate of depreciation of the zloty's central rate will fall to 0.8 percent a month as envisaged in the 1997 budget.
Presently the zloty's central parity rate is devalued one percent per month against a basket of five western currencies.
Solomon also said inflation pressures had slowed the decline in Polish interest rates and that prospects for further rate falls in coming months were limited.
